headings.usage: Page headers, large KPI metrics, modal titles.

body.usage: Standard text, labels, paragraphs, table text.

mono.usage: All numerical data (currency, IDs, dates, percentages). MUST right-align in tables.

colors.primary: hsl(160 84% 39%) - Emerald. Use for primary CTA, active states, focus rings.

diagnosis_and_ai_slop_removal.emojis: CRITICAL: Remove all emojis (📅, 📆, 🗓️, 🔄, 💡, ⚡) across the app, especially in forms and selects. Replace with monochrome Lucide React icons.
diagnosis_and_ai_slop_removal.generic_badges: Replace pill-shaped flat background badges with sharp 'Neo-Brutalist' badges: rounded-md, ring-1 inset, uppercase tracking-wider, text-xs. Adding a subtle dot before the text adds a professional touch.
diagnosis_and_ai_slop_removal.spacing_and_hierarchy: Avoid 'p-4 everywhere' (AI default). Use dynamic spacing: p-6 or p-8 for cards. Group related elements with tight spacing (gap-1 or gap-2) and separate distinct sections with macro spacing (gap-8 or mb-10).
diagnosis_and_ai_slop_removal.surfaces: Stop using standard drop-shadows on flat cards. Use ring-1 ring-border for definition. For modals/dropdowns, use backdrop-blur-xl with a 1px border.

desktop.issue: Horizontal scrolling in /clientes due to content overflow.
desktop.solution: Use `w-full table-fixed` on the table. Assign explicit percentage or specific width classes (e.g., `w-1/3`, `w-32`) to the `<th/>` elements. Use `truncate` and `max-w-0` on cells containing long text (names, emails). Wrap secondary info under primary info in the same column (e.g., email under name in muted text) to reduce column count.

mobile.solution: NEVER use `overflow-x-auto` to swipe tables on mobile. Instead, hide the `<table>` entirely on mobile (`hidden md:table`) and display the data as a list of stacked cards (`grid md:hidden gap-4`). Each card should show the primary identifier (Name/ID) at the top and key-value pairs for the rest of the data.

table_and_responsiveness.density: Use dense spacing for rows (`py-3 px-4`). Use JetBrains Mono for all numbers and strictly right-align numeric columns (headers and cells).

components.kpi_cards: Rounded-xl, ring-1 ring-border, p-6, hover:-translate-y-1 transition-transform. Large number in Cabinet Grotesk or JetBrains Mono, top right subtle Lucide icon.
components.avatars: Circular, bg-emerald-500/10 text-emerald-500, JetBrains Mono font for initials.
components.search_inputs: Minimalist. Bottom border only (`border-b border-border bg-transparent`), zero radius, focus:border-emerald-500. No heavy boxes.
components.empty_states: Faint Lucide icon (size 12, text-muted-foreground/30), Cabinet Grotesk header, Satoshi body. Centered layout is acceptable ONLY here.

motion_and_layers.page_load: Use framer-motion stagger logic for lists and dashboard cards (slide up 10px and fade in).
motion_and_layers.tabs: Use framer-motion `layoutId` for the active tab indicator (a 2px emerald underline).
motion_and_layers.interactive: All clickable elements must have active/hover states (e.g., hover:bg-muted/50 for table rows, brightness change for buttons).

instructions_to_main_agent: Apply the /pagamentos visual reference to /clientes, /dashboard, /emprestimos, /cadastros, and /equipe.
Completely purge the codebase of Emojis and replace them with Lucide React icons.
Fix the /clientes desktop table by implementing `table-fixed` and column widths, ensuring no horizontal scroll on standard monitors.
Implement the Mobile Card view for all tables (clientes, empréstimos, equipe).
Use data-testid attributes on all interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='new-client-btn').
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic 'AI slop' aesthetics. Embrace the Swiss/Old Money Tech vibe: high contrast, sharp typography, deliberate negative space.
NEVER use emojis. NEVER use transparent backgrounds for overlays, dropdowns, or sticky headers.
Do not use `transition: all`. Target specific properties.
Always right-align numbers and use monospace font.
Respect the dual theme (dark/light) with proper semantic color mappings via Tailwind classes.
As the project uses .js files, ensure all code updates follow standard JavaScript syntax and React patterns (avoiding TypeScript-specific typing overhead).
